identity.name: The Lucky Knot Wedding Chapel
identity.description: A 24-hour Las Vegas wedding chapel — plastic flowers, a heart-shaped neon arch buzzing on the wall, rows of cheap pews. Outside the stained-glass windows the sky is the wrong color. Something is pounding on the double doors.

connections.label: Out through the shattered doors to the Strip

ambient: The neon heart arch buzzes, dims, and catches again.
Something scrabbles across the roof and is gone.

art.prompt: A tacky neon Las Vegas wedding chapel interior at night during an apocalypse, heart-shaped neon arch, overturned pews, red sky through stained glass, B-movie horror, oil painting style

identity.name: The Apocalypse Kid
identity.description: Leather jacket, katana across the back, a wedding you were definitely not invited to. You don't know why the world is ending, but you intend to outlive it.

list.name: Guardian Ghost
list.special: Summon a spectral ally that fights for 3 turns.

list.name: Apocalypse Now
list.special: Overdrive finisher — rip the whole zone apart. Requires a full meter.

identity.name: Katana
identity.description: A folded-steel katana, scratched but razor-keen. Your one good decision this week.

identity.name: Padre Salt
identity.description: The chapel's Elvis-impersonator officiant, sequined jumpsuit half-burned, a pump shotgun where a hymnal should be. He is not, it turns out, an actual priest.

persona.personality: Loud, fast-talking, weirdly calm about the end of the world. Treats the apocalypse like a bad Tuesday shift.
persona.backstory: Twenty years marrying drunk strangers in this chapel. When the sky cracked he reached under the lectern for the shotgun he keeps for robberies.
persona.voice: Vegas lounge drawl, peppers speech with 'baby' and 'thankyaverymuch'. Gallows humor.

facts: The things at the door are imps — small, mean, and they travel in packs.
There's a Cadillac idling out front with the keys still in it; the groom ran off without it.
The whole Strip is on fire. Heading north toward Fremont is suicide; the car is the only way out.
secrets: He saw an angel with rainbow wings pull two people into the sky an hour ago and has decided not to mention it in case it sounds crazy.
He's out of shotgun shells after the next two blasts.

list.name: Shotgun Blast
list.special: A pump-shotgun roar — two shells, then he's dry.

art.prompt: Portrait of a Las Vegas Elvis impersonator preacher, half-burned sequined jumpsuit, pump shotgun, manic grin, neon light

identity.name: Snarling Imp
identity.description: A knee-high devil the color of a bruise, all teeth and claws, dripping something black onto the carpet.

persona.personality: Vicious, gleeful, dumb. Attacks the nearest warm thing.
persona.voice: High, scratchy, gleeful — taunts in broken English.

facts: We came through the rift to kill everything warm.
secrets: We fear the big one that comes after us far more than we fear you.

identity.name: The Las Vegas Strip
identity.description: The Strip in full apocalypse: a casino marquee shears off and crashes into the street, fire-hydrant geysers turn pink in the neon, and figures that are not people lope between the stalled cars. A cherry-red Cadillac idles at the curb, driver's door open, keys swinging in the ignition.

connections.label: Through the neon wreckage to the Silver Egg Casino
Past the burning marquees to the Chapel of Eternal Union

art.prompt: The Las Vegas Strip during the apocalypse, casino marquee crashing into the street, pink neon, stalled cars, a cherry-red Cadillac idling at the curb, distant demonic figures, red sky, B-movie horror, oil painting style

ambient: A slot machine inside a dead casino pays out to nobody.
Ash sifts down like snow onto the Cadillac's hood.
Two tuxedoed corpses stand beneath a wedding billboard, swaying as if waiting for a cue.
A distant casino sign blinks WELCOME HOME in letters missing every third bulb.

identity.name: Idling Cadillac
identity.description: A cherry-red convertible Cadillac, engine running, keys in the ignition, the groom nowhere in sight. Your ride out of this dying city — if you can reach it and floor it.

identity.name: Get Out of Vegas
identity.description: Survive the imps, reach the Strip, and steal the idling Cadillac to flee Las Vegas — the first leg of a much longer road through the Apocalypse.

steps: Survive the imps swarming the chapel.
Take the idling Cadillac and floor it out of the city.

identity.description: A wedding guest gone wrong — torn tux, black-veined eyes, moving in wrong little jerks.

persona.personality: Silent, twitching, relentless. A guest who never got to sit down.

identity.name: The Silver Egg Casino
identity.description: A silver-foil casino egg squats intact amid the ash, its roulette tables barricading the doors and its last neon halo warming a handful of stubborn survivors. Behind the old wedding-package desk, somebody has kept the coffee hot.

ambient: The roulette wheel keeps turning on a battery salvaged from a hearse.
Survivors trade wedding rings for canned peaches beneath the silver neon egg.

arrivalCombat.objective: Defend the holdout; victory earns the survivors as allies.

identity.name: The Chapel of Eternal Union
identity.description: A grand wedding chapel whose white facade is scorched black at the edges. Its eternal-flame marquee burns upside down, and beneath its marble altar something huge and red breathes between worlds.

ambient: A pipe organ plays one held chord with nobody at its keys.
Wedding invitations whirl around the altar like frightened white birds.

art.prompt: A ruined grand Las Vegas wedding chapel above a hellmouth, upside-down eternal-flame neon marquee, warm neon against grey ash, cinematic concept art

identity.name: Madame Keno
identity.description: The survivor leader in a rhinestone blazer, seated behind the casino wedding-package desk with a ledger that has outlived the world.

persona.personality: Cool-headed, maternal when it counts, and incapable of pretending she does not know a secret.
persona.backstory: She ran this casino's wedding-package desk for thirty years and remembers every bad vow and every worse lie.
persona.voice: Velvet casino-hostess warmth with the steel underneath.

facts: The hellmouth under the Chapel of Eternal Union was opened deliberately by Sammy Marchetti.
Sammy was best man at four hundred weddings and never once a groom.
The Cadillac needs fuel; the Silver Egg has a drum of it.
secrets: Sammy begged Madame Keno to put his name on a package once. She told him he could make a life without a bride, and has regretted the cruelty of it ever since.

list.name: Dealer's Nerve
list.special: A tiny pistol produced from beneath the ledger.

persona.personality: Laconic, watchful, and gentler than he lets on.
persona.backstory: A Wasteland Drifter who found the Egg before the doors closed and never left his post.

identity.name: Sammy "Forever" Marchetti
identity.description: A once-perfect best man in a smoke-stained tuxedo, wearing four hundred borrowed rings and a smile that cannot survive the next honest word.

persona.personality: Wounded, theatrical, furious at every promise he was asked to witness but never receive.
persona.backstory: Best man at four hundred weddings, never a groom. He opened the hellmouth deliberately when grief finally sounded like a vow.
persona.voice: A toastmaster's bright patter cracking into naked hurt.

identity.name: Running on Empty
identity.description: The Cadillac has wheels but no future without fuel. At the Silver Egg, decide whether to stand with the holdout or siphon what you need.

steps: Either defend the holdout from the imp wave (earn allies) or siphon the fuel.

identity.name: Something Borrowed
identity.description: Fuel the Cadillac, return to the chapel that began it all, and close the wound before Vegas becomes Hell's honeymoon suite.

steps: Reach the Chapel of Eternal Union.
Defeat or talk down Sammy Marchetti. Allies earned at the Egg raise his morale threshold; learning his story can also reach him.

resolution.epilogue: Dawn breaks on Boneyard Highway, the Cadillac finally rolling through grey ash toward a horizon that has not given up.
